title: Eaton Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Results
publisher: Eaton Corporation plc via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Second quarter sales were USD 8.5 billion, up 21%, with 14% organic growth; operating cash flow was USD 1.1 billion and free cash flow was USD 874 million.
summary: Eaton's SEC-filed Q2 release reports record sales, broad electrical order and backlog growth, 23.1% segment margin, stronger cash generation, raised organic-growth and adjusted-EPS guidance, and a planned Mobility separation.
